sloka: तं मन्मथशरैर्विद्धं कामवेगवशानुगम् ।उवाच पृथिवीपालं कैकेयी दारुणं वचः ॥२-११-१॥
transliteration: taṁ manmathaśarairviddhaṁ kāmavegavaśānugam ।uvāca pṛthivīpālaṁ kaikeyī dāruṇaṁ vacaḥ ॥2-11-1॥

translations.english: To the ruler of the earth (the king), struck by the darts of Kamadeva and overtaken by passion Kaikeyi spoke (these) dreadful words.
